_meta.anchor: the SUBSTRATE question, NOT debugging_philosophy §6.1: 'does resolving this omega require going OUTSIDE the constraint's declared fields (declared reading set + relations + v/b + ε), and if so to WHAT — a criterion (define->Ω_C), a decider (decide->Ω_P), or an observation (measure->Ω_E)? Or is it re-derivable from the declared fields (restatement)?' §6.1 used only as a sanity prior.

legend.fired: which resolution-operation signatures I judge present (define/decide/measure); >=2 = hybrid
legend.external_to: the LOCUS that is outside the declared fields: criterion | decider | observation | none(restatement)
legend.vs_authored: agree | mistyped->X (sound but wrong type) | restatement-mislabel (authored a type but routes nowhere external)
legend.control_role: KNOWN_EXTERNAL (gate must PASS) | KNOWN_RESTATEMENT (gate must CATCH) | UNDER_DECLARATION (gate must NOT call external-via-missing-reading a restatement) | none

held.name: global_south_development_path_constraint

held.name: committer_frame__biomedical_vs_critical_foreclosure
held.rationale: Conceptual analysis of whether 'discovery shaped by incentives' is compatible with 'genuine discovery' — a definitional/compatibility frontier. The declared relation STATES forecloses but does not ESTABLISH it, so the criterion is genuinely open (not restatement). CONTESTABLE: a strict reader could call the declared 'forecloses' relation a re-derivation.

held.name: kernel_reading_foreclosure
held.rationale: ON-TRIAL. 'Foreclose vs genuinely-irreconcilable normative commitments held by different parties' — the decider (different parties' normative commitments) is external to the declared set (decide->Ω_P), AND the approach establishes the foreclosure relation jurisprudentially (define->Ω_C). Genuine hybrid; authored conceptual among fired -> agreement (hybrid-aware).

held.name: kernel_reading_contest
held.rationale: ON-TRIAL CRUX. 'Which reading is structurally defensible' resolves by (c) normative political shift / which faction gains power = an external decider, plus (a) empirical falsification (measure). The deciding commitment is NOT in the constraint. Mistyped conceptual->Ω_P. Soundness-soft flag: consequence says 'not resolvable empirically; coexist indefinitely' — but a real external decider keeps it a frontier, not restatement.

held.name: kernel_reading_alternative_framing
held.rationale: ON-TRIAL. Resolution = 'generate the homoiousios sibling as a separate constraint story and compare authored ε / v / b'. The sibling is a DECLARED reading (homoiousios_reading forecloses); comparing its AUTHORED ε is re-derivation from declared fields, not an external observation. Consequence: 'documents the committer frame' — meta-commentary, fails Unlockability. Restatement / not-a-frontier.

held.name: committer_structure__liturgical_vs_native_reading_contest
held.rationale: ON-TRIAL. Resolution = 'clarify what "living" means in each framework' — explicit define operation; the criterion ('living' definition) is genuinely open and not declared. Clean Ω_C-define. A family member that is correctly conceptual -> proves the family is NOT uniformly mistyped.

held.name: kernel_reading_underdetermination
held.rationale: ON-TRIAL + control. Asks whether the declared 3-reading set is exhaustive — by construction depends on readings the constraint NEVER enumerated (libertarian/communitarian/ecological). The gate must route this EXTERNAL (criterion: complete the framework set), NOT call it restatement merely because 3 options are enumerated. Weak-Unlockability flag (consequence: 'does not change THIS classification').

held.name: kernel_reading_distinction
held.rationale: ON-TRIAL. Resolution = ε-invariance test across the husk and behavioral-competence readings — but both are DECLARED (behavioral_competence coexists_with) and ε is AUTHORED, not externally measured. Re-derivation of declared values -> restatement. CONTESTABLE: a reader who treats ε-measurement as a genuine external operation would call this measure-external Ω_E.

held.name: reading_committer_frame_dependence
held.rationale: ON-TRIAL, strongest legitimate-committer-frontier case (Seat Theorem Cor 2b). 'Does choosing this reading depend on the reader's theological/institutional position (committer frame)?' — the decider (the committer's position) is external to declared structure (decide->Ω_P), surveyed empirically (measure). Mistyped conceptual->Ω_P. This is 'sound-but-mistyped', the legitimate frontier reading.

held.name: kernel_reading_contest
held.rationale: ON-TRIAL, family-SPLIT evidence. 'Is Hanafi coexistent or does ascendance foreclose alternatives' resolves by an OBSERVABLE: are Hanbali/Maliki texts available, taught, suppressed. External fact -> measure -> Ω_E. Mistyped conceptual->Ω_E. Same NAME as id 19 (kernel_reading_contest) but diagnoses DIFFERENTLY (Ω_E vs Ω_P) -> the family is NOT one mechanism; per-omega resolution governs.
